document-api-4cfd4157f2.content: Browser-side dispatch router. document-api-4cfd4157f2.title: api.ts

document-architecture-fd45fecace.content: Comprehensive cross-runtime architecture reference with Mermaid diagrams for App/Page mounting, isolated runtimes, client sessions versus WebSockets, handler channels, render targeting, dispatch protocol, event/upload/cache flows, browser modules, generated assets, concurrency, and security boundaries.
document-architecture-fd45fecace.title: ARCHITECTURE.md

document-browser-client-24de80be4f.content: Focused TypeScript browser-runtime documentation covering module ownership, startup, same-route WebSocket and reconnect lifecycle, server-to-browser dispatch, DOM/event/form/upload behavior, lifecycle hooks, error propagation, type-contract synchronization, build, and tests.
document-browser-client-24de80be4f.title: BROWSER_CLIENT.md

document-cache-17a0f9e096.content: Implements generic Cache[T] state scoped to one browser client inside one Neith runtime. It owns cache creation/type checks, Set/Value/Delete, timestamps and expiry, stale-watcher protection, optional history, change/timeout callbacks, runtime-wide callback registry, and per-client cache stores guarded by mutexes.
document-cache-17a0f9e096.title: cache.go

document-cache-test-09c4ed59fa.content: Verifies typed cache creation and retrieval, duplicate and wrong-type behavior, mutation, timeout/expiry semantics, history and callbacks, cleanup, and isolation assumptions that make Cache[T] safe as per-client Neith state.
document-cache-test-09c4ed59fa.title: cache_test.go

document-component-5aae84baa5.content: Optional renderer-agnostic UI package built on neith.Component. It provides semantic layout, headings, forms, controls, selects, tables and alerts plus attribute/class/label/choice/state options, with HTML escaping and deterministic attribute rendering; it can be mixed with templ and custom components.
document-component-5aae84baa5.title: component.go

document-component-e3614f56b5.content: Defines Neith's minimal Component interface and the central FnComponent dispatch wrapper. It renders components into a buffered server-side wrapper, copies active runtime/session context, attaches browser events, selects tag/element render modes, supports redirect/error/custom JavaScript dispatch, immediate Dispatch, class and focused DOM helpers, removals, and raw HTML adaptation.
document-component-e3614f56b5.title: component.go

document-component-test-de907b648c.content: Tests optional UI component rendering, escaping, attributes/classes, labels, form controls, choice handling, tables, and composition into normal Neith components.
document-component-test-de907b648c.title: component_test.go

document-component-test-fbd19608ce.content: Tests Component/FnComponent rendering, wrapper metadata, target/mode selection, event wiring metadata, dispatch behavior, and convenience effects so public component APIs remain aligned with the dispatch protocol.
document-component-test-fbd19608ce.title: component_test.go

document-conn-fd198d86a2.content: Owns one Gorilla WebSocket transport for a Neith client session. It upgrades HTTP, attaches the connection to the runtime session registry, closes superseded sockets, decodes inbound Dispatch messages, serializes outbound messages, rejects writes from stale connections, and schedules inactive-session/cache cleanup after CacheTimeOut.
document-conn-fd198d86a2.title: conn.go

document-conn-test-b584c3fd7f.content: Exercises WebSocket connection/session lifecycle and publication behavior, especially the active-connection rule that prevents a superseded socket from writing after a reconnect.
document-conn-test-b584c3fd7f.title: conn_test.go

document-context-da930f05b1.content: Defines Neith context keys plus internal dispatchDetails carrying runtime, client ID, connection, and handler ID. These context values bind application handlers and FnComponents to the correct mounted runtime and browser session.
document-context-da930f05b1.title: context.go

document-custom-e26a3bffbf.content: Small browser-side custom JavaScript/example fixture used with Neith's custom function dispatch escape hatch; auxiliary client code rather than the core TypeScript runtime.
document-custom-e26a3bffbf.title: custom.js

document-development-plan-0926-1-70c9d19.title: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_0926-1.md

document-dispatch-03c3776c56.title: dispatch.go

document-dispatch-payloads-95590acbf7.content: Defines Go payload structs for each server/browser dispatch operation: rendering target/mode/HTML/listeners, ping liveness, class changes, focused DOM operations, redirects, custom JavaScript calls/results, and protocol errors.
document-dispatch-payloads-95590acbf7.title: dispatch_payloads.go

document-dispatch-test-e1c380ab56.title: dispatch_test.go

document-errors-2cac4a825d.content: Exports stable error values for missing Neith dispatch/event context, absent or failed client connections, and typed cache not-found/store/wrong-type/duplicate conditions.
document-errors-2cac4a825d.title: errors.go

document-event-listener-0159206200.content: Defines the supported DOM event-name constants, EventListener metadata, and the runtime/client-scoped event listener registry. Listener registration binds a Go HandleFn to a generated listener ID that the browser echoes in event dispatches.
document-event-listener-0159206200.title: event_listener.go

document-event-payloads-679a175e90.content: Serializes native browser events and DOM targets into JSON-safe payload structures that correspond to Go event_types.go, including event-specific coordinates/modifiers and source/component target snapshots.

document-event-types-2a164a2116.content: Defines exported JSON-safe event payloads shared with application handlers: Upload metadata, DOM EventTarget snapshots, pointer/mouse/keyboard/drag/touch data, and form-data event shapes.

document-runtime-e131050045.content: Defines the internal Neith runtime ownership boundary. A runtime groups its own handler pool, client sessions, event listeners, per-client cache stores, cache callbacks/history, and configuration; each MiddleWareFn/App mount creates one isolated runtime.

document-runtime-test-b1f2a58e66.content: Tests runtime construction/configuration and the isolation assumptions used to keep separate mounted Neith apps from sharing handler/session/cache/listener state.

document-session-85abe9ea35.content: Implements clientSession and its registry. A stable browser client ID can survive WebSocket replacement; Attach installs one active connection and returns the prior one, Detach only clears the matching connection, and inactive sessions can be deleted after timeout.
document-session-85abe9ea35.title: session.go

document-session-test-c6ad022b2d.content: Verifies session attach, active-connection replacement, detach semantics, lookup, and inactive deletion behavior used by reconnection and cache retention.

document-settings-89aa447020.content: Repository-local VS Code settings used by contributors; editor configuration with no effect on the Neith wire protocol or package runtime.

document-socket-ca8573f68e.content: Browser WebSocket lifecycle owner. It derives a same-route ws/wss URL, persists a stable neith client key in localStorage, creates API per connection, emits connect/disconnect/reconnect hooks, and retries unexpected disconnects with capped exponential backoff from 500 ms to 30 seconds.

document-upload-e30516784a.content: Implements Neith's multipart HTTP upload endpoint used before WebSocket event dispatch. It enforces configurable body/memory limits, creates a private upload directory, strips client path components, stores UUID-prefixed files with restrictive permissions, and returns Upload metadata; successful file retention/deletion remains the host application's responsibility.

document-upload-test-941b568acd.content: Tests multipart upload method handling, persistence, metadata, directory selection, size/memory behavior, and related safeguards in upload.go.

document-uploads-30758b33d8.content: Browser form/upload transport helper. It separates normal form values from files, preserves submitter name/value including a compatibility fallback, uploads selected files by multipart HTTP to neith_upload=1 with the stable client ID, and returns server Upload metadata for the later event dispatch.
document-uploads-30758b33d8.title: uploads.ts

document-usage-d6b4130f82.content: Comprehensive current-source usage guide covering installation, minimal App/View setup, rendering and targets, events, uploads, generic cache, page/config options, DOM effects, redirects/custom JavaScript, optional ui components, multiple routes, production cautions, and exported errors.

event-system.content: Server-rendered wrappers carry listener metadata. The browser binds native events, serializes JSON-safe payloads and listener identity, and Go resolves the handler in the current runtime/client scope before invoking it with EventKey context.
event-system.title: Event system

example-consumer.content: examples/readme-setup is a consumer-style Go module showing Neith with templ and local styling, including generated templ output and a runnable HTTP server.

image-logo-89d7ff4477.title: logo.png

neith-system.content: Neith is a Go-first server-rendered interactive component system. Go owns rendering, event handlers, state and the authoritative dispatch protocol; a thin TypeScript browser runtime owns WebSocket transport, DOM effects, event capture, uploads and lifecycle hooks.
neith-system.title: Neith system

server-runtime.content: Each mounted Neith app owns an isolated runtime containing handlers, client sessions, event listeners, cache stores and config. A stable browser client ID may survive WebSocket replacement while only one connection remains active at a time.
server-runtime.title: Server runtime and sessions

static-branding.content: Tracked logo, icon, favicon, manifest, historical static shell and image metadata provide project/browser identity or historical static context. They are separate from the two runtime assets embedded by page.go.
